title: The Promised Neverland
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eleven-year-old Emma and her friends live in an idyllic orphanage until they discover they are being raised as food for demons. Emma, Norman and Ray plan an escape, and the children later fight to free those on other farms and end the arrangement between humans and demons.
life_message: It holds up protecting every member of the family, refusing to leave anyone behind even at great cost.
